synthesis: A search of the arXiv database for papers published in 2026 containing the phrase "phase1 smoke test" returned no directly relevant results. The returned papers focus on video generation, adaptive agents, 3D asset creation, and theoretical physics, none of which discuss or apply the concept of a Phase 1 smoke test—a preliminary validation step commonly used in software or hardware development pipelines. Semantic Scholar query also failed due to rate limiting, providing no additional data. Consequently, there is currently no publicly available literature from 2026 that addresses Phase 1 smoke testing; further investigation may require expanding the search terms (e.g., "smoke test", "initial validation", "pre‑release testing") or consulting industry whitepapers and technical reports not indexed in academic repositories.
